verdict.en: A low-priority gadget blueprint: you can buy the camera from Shani, so only learn this if you land a spare copy.
verdict.zh: 低优先级的道具蓝图：相机可直接找萨尼买，捡到多余的再学。

obtain.en: The community wiki only lists scavenging, with no confirmed container or map. The camera itself sells at Shani and is a free Reward Pass item, so there is no reason to hunt the blueprint.
obtain.zh: 社区维基只标注了搜刮，未确认具体容器或地图。相机本身萨尼有售，奖励通行证也有免费版，不必专门去找蓝图。

tips.en: The blueprint cannot be researched at the Research Station and the wiki lists it as a requirement for an Outpost project, so keep it if you have the project open.
tips.zh: 该蓝图不能在研究站研究，且维基把它列为某个前哨项目的需求，若项目在做就留着。

verdict.en: Cheap early attachment: learn it if it drops, otherwise research it at the Research Station.
verdict.zh: 入门级配件蓝图：掉了就学，没掉就去研究站研究。

obtain.en: It turns up in Residential loot on every map. Research Station 2 can also research it for Research Points, ARC Flex Rubber and Mechanical Components, so don't farm for it.
obtain.zh: 各地图的住宅类容器都可能出。研究站 2 级也能用研究点数、ARC弹性橡胶和机械元件研究出来，不值得专门刷。

tips.en: A duplicate sells for 5,000 coins, so sell extras instead of holding them.
tips.zh: 重复的蓝图能卖 5000 钱币，多的直接卖。

verdict.en: Worth learning for recoil control, but it only rolls reliably in harder conditions.
verdict.zh: 压枪效果明显值得学，但只在高难度条件下比较稳定地出。

obtain.en: Residential containers on any map, with a better chance during Electromagnetic Storm, Locked Gate and Night Raid. It cannot be researched at the Research Station, so scavenging is the only route.
obtain.zh: 各图居民区容器，电磁风暴、上锁的大门、夜间奇袭时机会更高。研究站研究不了，只能靠搜刮。

tips.en: Learning it needs Gunsmith 3, so check your bench level before spending a Night Raid on it.
tips.zh: 学习需要武器工作台 3 级，刷夜袭前先看看工作台等级。

verdict.en: A solid mid-game hand cannon to learn, but expect a slow chase: it is an epic, so it rolls less often than Bettina.
verdict.zh: 值得学的中期手炮，但属于史诗蓝图，出货比贝蒂娜慢，要有耐心。

obtain.en: Raider containers on any map and condition; guides rank it behind Bettina in how often it appears. You can also research it at Research Station 2 using Research Points and Bully Fragmenter, which is the more reliable route.
obtain.zh: 各图奇袭者类容器都可能出，出货率比“贝蒂娜”低。也可在研究站 2 级用研究点数和恶霸破片弹研究，这条路更稳。

tips.en: Learning needs Gunsmith 2 and Heavy Gun Parts, so stock those before you run a lucky copy.
tips.zh: 学习要武器工作台 2 级和重型枪械零件，先备好材料。

verdict.en: A top-tier priority, but learning it is the easy part: the Matriarch Reactor needed to craft it is the real gate.
verdict.zh: 顶级优先级，但学会只是第一步，真正卡脖子的是制作所需的“族母”反应堆。

obtain.en: It now drops from loot on Stella Montis, not from the Matriarch boss as it did before patch 1.7. Guides point to the top layer of Cultural Archives and Medical Research and the bottom layer of the Control Room. Night Raid doubles blueprint spawns.
obtain.zh: 现在掉在星辰山的搜刮物里，不再从“族母”身上拿（1.7 版本起）。攻略推荐文化档案馆、医学研究部上层以及控制室下层。夜间奇袭会让蓝图刷新翻倍。

tips.en: Start learning only when you can afford 3 Magnetic Accelerators, 3 Complex Gun Parts and a Matriarch Reactor.
tips.zh: 备齐 3 个磁力加速器、3 个复杂枪械零件和一个“族母”反应堆再动手学。

verdict.en: A novelty blueprint with no known source yet: ignore it unless you collect gadgets.
verdict.zh: 纯娱乐向的新蓝图，来源尚不明确，不收集道具就无视。

obtain.en: The community wiki has no page for the blueprint and the Banjo page lists no sources. It is a Frozen Trail 2.0 gadget, so keep any copy you find until sources are known.
obtain.zh: 社区维基没有该蓝图页面，班卓琴页面也没列出来源。属于冰封小径 2.0 新增道具，捡到先留着，等来源明确。

tips.en: The Banjo only attracts attention and blocks two-handed actions while played, so it adds no combat value.
tips.zh: 班卓琴只能吸引注意，演奏时无法做双手动作，没有战斗价值。

verdict.en: A cheap 2.0 revolver blueprint you can research yourself, so do not farm for it.
verdict.zh: 2.0 新增的廉价左轮蓝图，可以自己研究，不用专门刷。

obtain.en: The wiki lists scavenging and the Research Station without specific containers. Research Station 1 can produce it for 3,000 Research Points and 8 Hornet Drivers, which is the realistic path.
obtain.zh: 维基只写了搜刮和研究站，没有具体容器。研究站 1 级用 3000 研究点数和 8 个“马蜂”引擎就能研究，这是现实路线。

tips.en: Hornet Drivers come from Hornets, so kill a few on the way before queuing the research.
tips.zh: “马蜂”引擎来自马蜂，顺路多打几只再排研究。

verdict.en: Useful utility, easy to get: pick it up when electrical containers give it, no need to chase.
verdict.zh: 实用但好拿的工具蓝图，电气类容器出了就学，不必追。

obtain.en: Look in Electrical containers; every map can roll it. Research is the easier route: 1,000 Research Points and Rusty ARC Steel at the Research Station.
obtain.zh: 电子类容器里找，各地图都可能出。研究站用 1000 研究点数加生锈的ARC钢材研究更省事，没必要刷。

tips.en: Learning needs Utility Station 2, so upgrade that first.
tips.zh: 学习需要工具工作台 2 级，先升级。

verdict.en: The easiest epic weapon blueprint to land, and worth learning because the gun stays useful against armored ARC.
verdict.zh: 最容易刷到的史诗武器蓝图，对付装甲 ARC 依然好用，值得学。

obtain.en: Raider containers on any map, and guides call it one of the most frequently rolled epics. Reported spots: Dam apartments (Ruby Residence, Pale Apartments, Pattern House), Research and Administration, and Stella Montis Loading Bay. Hurricane First Wave Caches also give it.
obtain.zh: 各图奇袭者类容器，攻略称它是出得比较多的史诗蓝图。常见点位：大坝公寓区、研究与管理楼、星辰山装卸区。飓风期间的第一波箱也能开出。

tips.en: Drop rate was cut after an early bug, so use short runs through many containers rather than long fights.
tips.zh: 早期有 bug 导致爆率偏高，后来已下调，建议快进快出多开容器。

verdict.en: Nice-to-have fire grenade; learn it when it shows up, but nothing else depends on it.
verdict.zh: 锦上添花的火焰手雷，出了就学，其他东西不依赖它。

obtain.en: Only scavenging: it rolls from Industrial containers anywhere, and the wiki lists no Research Station recipe for it.
obtain.zh: 只能搜刮：任意地图的工业类容器都可能出，维基没有列出研究站配方。

tips.en: Crafting needs Explosives Station 3, Explosive Compound and Oil, so check those before you count on it.
tips.zh: 制作需要爆炸物工作台 3 级、炸药混合物和油，别指望前期用上。

verdict.en: Skip it unless you want cheap lighting: any copy is better sold for 5,000 coins.
verdict.zh: 除非想要廉价照明，否则直接卖掉换 5000 钱币。

obtain.en: Any container on any map and condition can roll it. It cannot be researched at the Research Station.
obtain.zh: 任何地图、任何条件下的容器都可能出。无法在研究站研究。

tips.en: Learning it needs Utility Station 2 and Chemicals; for a throwable light that is a poor deal.
tips.zh: 学习需要工具工作台 2 级和化学品，只为一根荧光棒不太划算。

verdict.en: The most valuable blueprint here and also the hardest, so lock it in through the Trophy Display project.
verdict.zh: 这批里最值钱也最难拿的蓝图，优先走战利品展示架项目拿到手。

obtain.en: Trophy Display project Stage 4 gives one, which is the dependable route. Otherwise it drops in Blue Gate Locked Gate loot or in First Wave Caches during Hurricane, and Trials reward it too. Wild spawns are extremely rare.
obtain.zh: 战利品展示架项目第 4 阶段给一张，这是最稳的路线。其他途径是蓝门上锁的大门事件、飓风期间的第一波箱，试炼也给奖励。野外自然刷新极少。

tips.en: Aim for 3 stars on weekly Trials, which players report as a Bobcat source.
tips.zh: 每周试炼尽量拿满 3 星，玩家反馈能拿到山猫蓝图。

tips.en: The base Bobcat is weak, so you craft it mainly to upgrade it, which needs Gunsmith 3.
tips.zh: 基础款山猫较弱，学来主要是为了升级，需要武器工作台 3 级。

verdict.en: Free early pistol blueprint: finish the Industrial Espionage quest and you never need to hunt it.
verdict.zh: 免费的早期手枪蓝图：完成“工业间谍”任务就有，别去刷。

obtain.en: Quest reward for Industrial Espionage from Tian Wen in Buried City, after Eyes On The Prize. You can use any Burletta for the delivery step, but do not hand over your modded one. It can also be researched at Research Station 1.
obtain.zh: 掩埋废城天玟的任务“工业间谍”奖励，需先完成前置任务。交付时任何布尔莱塔都行，别交改装过的。研究站 1 级也能研究。

tips.en: A duplicate blueprint sells for 5,000 coins.
tips.zh: 多出来的蓝图能卖 5000 钱币。

verdict.en: A good SMG blueprint, but only Hurricane First Wave Caches give it, so plan a long low-risk farm.
verdict.zh: 不错的冲锋枪蓝图，只有飓风的第一波箱出，适合安排一次长时间低风险刷取。

obtain.en: Hurricane only, from First Wave Caches (small buried caches that hum when close) on every map except Stella Montis. Dam has the highest cache density, Blue Gate is a favorite, Buried City the lowest. One source claims Close Scrutiny weapon cases; it is unverified.
obtain.zh: 仅飓风期间，开第一波箱获得，除星辰山外各图都有。大坝箱子最密，蓝门也受欢迎，掩埋废城最少。有说法称严密排查的武器箱也出，未证实。

tips.en: Players farm it with an empty loadout and the blueprint in a safe pocket, then surrender so a death costs nothing.
tips.zh: 常见刷法是空装备入场，蓝图放安全口袋，没找到就投降重来，损失为零。

tips.en: Expect roughly 1 to 2 hours of farming per copy.
tips.zh: 预计每张要刷一到两小时。

verdict.en: A late-game augment worth learning for the extra shield support if you can find it.
verdict.zh: 后期护甲增幅，若能刷到，值得学来获得更强护盾支持。

obtain.en: Medical and security containers on Stella Montis and The Blue Gate, any condition. It cannot be researched at the Research Station, so you need a scavenged copy.
obtain.zh: 星辰山和蓝门的医疗与安保类容器，任何条件。研究站研究不了，必须搜刮到。

tips.en: Learning needs Gear Bench 3, Advanced Electrical Components and Processors.
tips.zh: 学习要装备工作台 3 级、高级电子元件和处理器。

verdict.en: The mobility-focused Mk. 3 augment; learn it if you play fast, but it is optional.
verdict.zh: 偏机动的 Mk. 3 增幅，打法灵活的玩家可学，属于可选。

obtain.en: Medical and security containers on Stella Montis and The Blue Gate. Unlike Aggressive, it can also be researched at Research Station 3 for 3,000 Research Points and ARC Circuitry.
obtain.zh: 星辰山和蓝门的医疗与安保类容器。与进攻型不同，它还可在研究站 3 级用 3000 研究点数和ARC线圈研究。

tips.en: Same Gear Bench 3 requirement as the other Mk. 3 augment.
tips.zh: 学习条件和另一款 Mk. 3 一样，要装备工作台 3 级。

verdict.en: Cheap and easy: research it or take it from residential containers, no farming needed.
verdict.zh: 便宜好拿：自己研究或从居民区容器捡，不用专门刷。

obtain.en: Residential containers on any map and condition. Research Station 2 also makes it for 2,000 Research Points, Rusty ARC Steel and a Cooling Coil.
obtain.zh: 各图居民区容器都可能出。研究站 2 级用 2000 研究点数、生锈的ARC钢材和冷却管也能研究。

tips.en: Learning needs Gunsmith 2.
tips.zh: 学习需要武器工作台 2 级。

verdict.en: Worth learning for steadier shots, but it only drops in harder conditions, so be patient.
verdict.zh: 能让射击更稳值得学，但只在高难度条件下出，需要耐心。

obtain.en: Residential containers during Electromagnetic Storm, Locked Gate and Night Raid. No Research Station route is listed, so it has to be scavenged.
obtain.zh: 电磁风暴、上锁的大门、夜间奇袭期间的居民区容器。没有研究站途径，只能搜刮。

tips.en: Learning needs Gunsmith 3 and 8 Wires.
tips.zh: 学习需要武器工作台 3 级和 8 根导线。

verdict.en: Strong long-term pick: it makes a material that late weapons keep asking for, so learn it early.
verdict.zh: 长期收益高：后期武器一直要用的材料，越早学越好。

obtain.en: Security containers on any map and condition. Research Station 3 can also make it for 3,000 Research Points plus 2 Complex Gun Parts and Advanced Mechanical Components, so you need parts before you can research it.
obtain.zh: 各图各条件下的安保类容器。研究站 3 级也能研究，但要先交 2 个复杂枪械零件和高级机械元件。

tips.en: Aphelion and Bettina recipes use Complex Gun Parts.
tips.zh: “远日点”“贝蒂娜”等武器的配方都要复杂枪械零件。

verdict.en: A minor utility blueprint; the Research Station makes it cheaply, so skip the hunt.
verdict.zh: 次要工具蓝图，研究站成本很低，不用专门找。

obtain.en: Any container on Riven Tides, any condition. Research Station 1 can produce it for 1,000 Research Points and 5 Durable Cloth.
obtain.zh: 裂潮镇任何容器、任何条件。研究站 1 级用 1000 研究点数和 5 块耐磨布料即可研究。

tips.en: Only worth the bench slot if you often drop from high places.
tips.zh: 只有常从高处跳的人才值得占位置。

verdict.en: A strong trap blueprint that is fairly farmable if you run Stella Montis in a duo.
verdict.zh: 强力陷阱蓝图，双排跑星辰山相对好刷。

obtain.en: Stella Montis, any condition. Guides name the Staff Room by the Loading Bay (stairs down, right, through the gate), then the red locker and corner bins. Player estimates: 2 to 3 per run for duos by day.
obtain.zh: 星辰山，任何条件。攻略指向装卸区旁的员工室（下楼右转过门），先搜红色柜子和角落垃圾桶。玩家估计白天双排每局 2 到 3 张。

tips.en: The room sits near the Loading Bay, which is contested, so expect other squads.
tips.zh: 该房间靠近装卸区，人多，注意其他小队。

verdict.en: A good team revive tool; learn it if you play with friends, otherwise it is optional.
verdict.zh: 团队复活利器，组队玩家建议学，单排可选。

obtain.en: Medical containers on any map and condition. It can also drop in Buried City Night Raids, in the two main rooms on the left side of the second-highest floor. Research Station 2 needs Syringes and Adrenaline Shots.
obtain.zh: 各图各条件下的医疗类容器。掩埋废城夜间奇袭里，次高层左侧两个主要房间也可能出。研究站 2 级需要注射器和肾上腺素。

tips.en: Learning needs Medical Lab 2.
tips.zh: 学习需要医疗实验室 2 级。

verdict.en: A top anti-ARC shotgun blueprint, but a long grind that only the Close Scrutiny event gives.
verdict.zh: 顶级的对 ARC 霰弹枪蓝图，但只有严密排查事件出，需要长期刷。

obtain.en: Close Scrutiny only, from breaching ARC Assessors. Each has three chambers, so three rolls. It does not drop from raider caches. Drop rate is low; some players breach 10 or more without one.
obtain.zh: 仅严密排查事件，破开大型 ARC 目标的舱室获得。每个有三个舱室，三次机会。不会从奇袭者箱里出。爆率偏低，有玩家破开十多个都没拿到。

tips.en: Crafting needs Vaporizer Regulators, which only drop during Close Scrutiny, so farm them in the same runs.
tips.zh: 制作要“汽化者”调节器，只在严密排查期间掉落，同一局顺手刷。

tips.en: Bring Energy Clips: they are expensive to buy or craft.
tips.zh: 带足能量弹匣，买和做都不便宜。

verdict.en: Only worth chasing if you want into the Fallen Emperor; the blueprint is a one-time unlock with a repeatable craft.
verdict.zh: 只有想进“陨落帝王”才值得追，学一次永久可造。

obtain.en: Farm the Redirection condition on Pendola Pass: harvest an Emperor Beacon from a Damaged Emperor Relay (red beam), deploy it in the open, then breach the Harvester Payload. The payload can hold the blueprint and the three couplers, but it is not guaranteed.
obtain.zh: 在彭多拉山口刷“航向重定向”：从受损的“帝王”中继器（红色光柱）取得“帝王”信标，在开阔处投放，再破开“收割者”空投搜刮。空投可能出蓝图和三种耦合器，但不保底。

tips.en: Craft needs one each of the Insulated, Conductive and Plated ARC Couplers, which come from the same payloads, so keep farming after you learn it.
tips.zh: 合成需要绝缘、导电、装甲三种 ARC 耦合器各一个，同样出自空投，学会后还得继续刷。

tips.en: One guide says the Conduit also sits at Frozen Trail Reward Pass level 60; the local data does not confirm it.
tips.zh: 有攻略称“霜痕小径”奖励通行证 60 级也能直接拿到导管，本站数据未证实。

tips.en: Bring a grappling or snap hook for the vertical sections inside.
tips.zh: 里面有垂直地形，带上钩爪或安全钩。

verdict.en: A Harvester-event prize: great if you can also farm a Queen Reactor, but the blueprint alone makes nothing.
verdict.zh: “收割者”事件大奖，还得再打出“女王”反应堆才能造。

obtain.en: Not in regular containers. Run the Harvester event (Dam Battlegrounds or Spaceport): finish the puzzle for the three reward containers, each reportedly holding one top-tier blueprint, Equalizer or Jupiter. The Queen Core is the other source. Learn it after extracting.
obtain.zh: 普通容器不出。参加“收割者”事件（大坝战场或太空港）：完成谜题后的三个奖励箱，据称各有一份顶级蓝图（制裁者或木星）；击败“女王”的核心也有机会。撤离后再学习。

tips.en: The Queen Reactor only comes from killing the Queen, so you must beat her at least once to craft it, even if you sneaked in for the blueprint.
tips.zh: “女王”反应堆只有击败“女王”才掉，即便偷进去拿了蓝图，造枪仍要打她一次。

tips.en: Duplicate copies still sell for 5,000 coins.
tips.zh: 重复的蓝图仍可卖 5000 钱币。

tips.en: Event windows are reported at fixed UTC hours; check the in-game map icon rather than trusting guide times.
tips.zh: 事件时段据报道固定在几个 UTC 整点，以游戏内地图图标为准。

verdict.en: The better pick of the two Harvester rewards if you snipe, but it also needs a Queen Reactor.
verdict.zh: 喜欢狙击就选它，同样要“女王”反应堆。

obtain.en: Harvester event only: sneak past the Queen when she faces away, solve the interior puzzle, and open the three reward containers. Each is reported to hold either Jupiter or Equalizer, so two runs may not give you both. Learn it after extracting.
obtain.zh: 仅出自“收割者”事件：趁“女王”背对时潜入，完成内部谜题后开三个奖励箱，据称每箱是木星或制裁者二选一，不一定一次拿齐。撤离后学习。

tips.en: The blueprint does not require killing the Queen, but crafting does because of the Queen Reactor.
tips.zh: 拿蓝图不用打“女王”，造枪却要她掉的“女王”反应堆。

tips.en: Do not recycle a duplicate; it sells for 5,000 coins.
tips.zh: 多余的蓝图别拆，可卖 5000 钱币。

verdict.en: Nice to have, not urgent; buy it with Research Points once you have Research Station 2.
verdict.zh: 不急；研究站 2 级后用研究点数换即可。

obtain.en: Drops while scavenging; one guide points to industrial containers (green drawers and lockers, industrial cleaners). The sure route is the Research Station 2: 2,000 Research Points, 3 Comet Igniters and 2 Sensors.
obtain.zh: 搜刮可得，有攻略推荐工业类容器（绿色抽屉、柜子、工业清洁车）。稳妥的办法是研究站 2 级：2000 研究点数、3 个“彗星”点火器、2 个传感器。

tips.en: The mine itself is crafted at Explosives Station 3, so the blueprint is no use before that bench.
tips.zh: 地雷本身要爆炸物工作台 3 级才能造，没升级前蓝图用不上。

verdict.en: The cheapest mine to unlock; fine for a stamina-drain trap, not a priority.
verdict.zh: 最便宜的地雷蓝图，当耐力陷阱用，不必优先。

obtain.en: Scavenging, or the Research Station 1 for 1,000 Research Points and 3 Household Cleaner. The station route is cheap and early, so don't hunt for a drop.
obtain.zh: 搜刮或研究站 1 级：1000 研究点数加 3 个家用清洁剂。门槛低，不用专门刷掉落。

tips.en: The mine is made at Explosives Station 1 from Chemicals and Rubber Parts, so it is one of the earliest mines you can run.
tips.zh: 地雷用化学品和橡胶零件在爆炸物工作台 1 级就能造，是最早能用上的地雷之一。

verdict.en: A stun trap that is handy for holding a door; learn it only if you like trap play.
verdict.zh: 能眩晕敌人的陷阱，适合守门，爱玩陷阱再学。

obtain.en: Scavenging, or the Research Station 2: 2,000 Research Points, 3 Advanced ARC Powercells and 1 Industrial Battery. No quest hands it out.
obtain.zh: 搜刮或研究站 2 级：2000 研究点数、3 个高级ARC能量电池、1 个工业级电池。没有任务送。

tips.en: Powercells are the expensive part of the Research Station route, so check you can spare them first.
tips.zh: 研究站路线最贵的是电池，先确认能匀出来。

verdict.en: Low priority: a modest velocity boost for a few guns.
verdict.zh: 优先级低，只给少数枪小幅提速。

use.en: The barrel adds about 20% bullet velocity and 10% more distance before falloff, and fits Tempest, Arpeggio, Bettina, Anvil and Torrente only.
use.zh: 枪管提高约 20% 弹速、衰减距离增加 10%，只适配“风暴”“三连奏”“贝蒂娜”“铁砧”和“奔流”。

obtain.en: Scavenging, or the Research Station 2: 2,000 Research Points, 5 Rusty ARC Steel and 1 Steel Cable. Crafting the barrel also needs Gunsmith 2.
obtain.zh: 搜刮或研究站 2 级：2000 研究点数、5 个生锈的ARC钢材、1 根钢缆。造枪管还需武器工作台 2 级。

tips.en: Pass on it unless one of those guns is your main.
tips.zh: 主力枪不在适配名单里就别学。

verdict.en: Worth learning for a long-range build: the best barrel, but it can't be researched.
verdict.zh: 长距离配装值得学，但不能靠研究站获得。

use.en: Gives about 30% bullet velocity and 15% more falloff distance at the cost of 15% extra vertical recoil, on thirteen weapons from Ferro to Tempest.
use.zh: 弹速约 +30%、衰减距离 +15%，代价是垂直后坐力 +15%，适配从“生铁”到“风暴”的十三把枪。

obtain.en: Scavenging only; the page says it cannot be bought at the Research Station. The quest A Rising Tide hands out the barrel itself, not the blueprint.
obtain.zh: 只能搜刮，研究站不能换。任务“涨潮”送的是成品枪管，不是蓝图。

tips.en: Crafting needs Gunsmith 3, 2 Mod Components and 8 Wires.
tips.zh: 合成需要武器工作台 3 级、2 个改装零件、8 根导线。

verdict.en: Skip it unless you craft in bulk: the mag is on sale from traders already.
verdict.zh: 不批量造就别学，商人那里就能买到弹匣。

obtain.en: Scavenging or the Research Station 2: 2,000 Research Points, 5 Dried-Out ARC Resin, 5 Wires.
obtain.zh: 搜刮或研究站 2 级：2000 研究点数、5 个干涸的ARC树脂、5 根导线。

tips.en: The finished mag (+10 rounds, fits Hairpin, Kettle, Stitcher, Burletta, Bobcat) is sold by Shani for 100 Cred and by Tian Wen for 6,000 coins, and quests Market Correction and Snap and Salvage give one.
tips.zh: 成品弹匣（+10 发，适配发夹、水壶、钉机、布尔莱塔、山猫）萨尼卖 100 信用点，天玟卖 6000 钱币；任务“矫正市场规则”“拍照并拆解回收”也各送一个。

verdict.en: Worth keeping if you run a light-ammo SMG; there is no other way to get the Mk. III mag.
verdict.zh: 常用轻型弹药冲锋枪就留着，别的渠道拿不到 III 级弹匣。

obtain.en: Scavenging only; it is not available at the Research Station. Treat it as a lucky find.
obtain.zh: 只能搜刮，研究站没有，属于撞运气。

tips.en: Craft needs Gunsmith 3, 2 Mod Components and 5 Steel Springs.
tips.zh: 合成需要武器工作台 3 级、2 个改装零件、5 个钢质弹簧。

verdict.en: Not needed: the mag is cheap from Shani and a quest gives one.
verdict.zh: 没必要学，萨尼有便宜成品，任务也送一个。

obtain.en: Scavenging or the Research Station 2: 2,000 Research Points, 5 Dried-Out ARC Resin, 3 Canisters.
obtain.zh: 搜刮或研究站 2 级：2000 研究点数、5 个干涸的ARC树脂、3 个小罐。

tips.en: Shani sells the mag (+8 rounds) for 100 Cred, 2 a day, and the quest Eyes on the Prize gives one.
tips.zh: 萨尼每天限 2 个、100 信用点 出售成品（+8 发）；任务“目光长远”也送一个。

verdict.en: A good find for medium-ammo guns, but only found by scavenging.
verdict.zh: 中型弹药枪的好东西，但只能靠搜刮。

obtain.en: Scavenging only; the Research Station does not offer it.
obtain.zh: 只能搜刮，研究站没有。

tips.en: If you only need one mag, quests Collision Course and Outstanding Balance reward a finished one, so the blueprint is for repeat crafting.
tips.zh: 只要一个的话，任务“碰撞航线”和“未结债务”会送成品，蓝图是为了反复造。

verdict.en: Only for Il Toro or Vulcano users, and one comes free from a quest.
verdict.zh: 只给“公牛”和“火山”用，任务还送一个。

obtain.en: Scavenging or the Research Station 2: 2,000 Research Points, 5 Dried-Out ARC Resin, 1 Mechanical Components.
obtain.zh: 搜刮或研究站 2 级：2000 研究点数、5 个干涸的ARC树脂、1 个机械元件。

tips.en: The mag adds +4 shells; the quest Eyes on the Prize gives one, so skip the blueprint if you only run one gun.
tips.zh: 弹匣 +4 发；任务“目光长远”送一个，只用一把枪就不必学。

verdict.en: Keep it if you main a shotgun; it comes only from loot.
verdict.zh: 主玩霰弹枪就留着，只能靠搜刮。

obtain.en: Scavenging only, with no Research Station option. Check containers while you farm; no specific spot is documented.
obtain.zh: 只能搜刮，研究站不能换。没有确切刷点记录，搜箱子时顺手找。

tips.en: Plan Gunsmith 3, 2 Mod Components and 5 Steel Springs ahead.
tips.zh: 提前备好武器工作台 3 级、2 个改装零件、5 个钢质弹簧。

verdict.en: You get it free from a quest; it is a fun toy, not a priority.
verdict.zh: 任务白送，是个乐子道具，不用优先。

obtain.en: Reward for the quest Test Case from Apollo (after The League). It also drops while scavenging, reportedly under the Cold Snap condition.
obtain.zh: 完成阿波罗的任务“测试案例”（在“球队”之后）获得；寒潮条件下搜刮也可能出。

tips.en: The finished box is sold by Shani for 60 Cred, 3 a day, so crafting is only worth it if you want many.
tips.zh: 成品萨尼每天限 3 个、60 信用点 出售，想要很多才值得自己造。

verdict.en: Cheap to unlock and useful in 2.0; get it at the Research Station.
verdict.zh: 解锁便宜，2.0 里实用，直接去研究站换。

obtain.en: Research Station 1 for 2,000 Research Points and 10 Rope, or scavenging. The blueprint is new in 2.0.
obtain.zh: 研究站 1 级：2000 研究点数加 10 根绳子，或搜刮。蓝图为 2.0 新增。

tips.en: Quests Belly of the Beast, Boarding the Frigate, Ruins and Reverberations and Tracks of the Beast each give one hook, so you can try one before spending.
tips.zh: 任务“兽腹深处”、登上“护卫者”、“废墟和回响”、“巨兽踪迹”各送一个钩爪，可先试用再决定。

tips.en: Players also recommend a hook for the Fallen Emperor's vertical sections.
tips.zh: 玩家也建议带钩子进“陨落帝王”。

verdict.en: Skip it: light sticks are bought for pennies and the blueprint is rarely worth the slot.
verdict.zh: 不必学，荧光棒本来就便宜。

obtain.en: Scavenging only. A player report put light-stick blueprints in the Blue Gate breach room and Buried City pharmacies, but this is unverified.
obtain.zh: 只能搜刮。有玩家称蓝门破门房和掩埋废城药店较常见，未经验证。

tips.en: Apollo sells the stick for 450 coins and Shani for 10 Cred. The quest In My Image needs 5, so buy those.
tips.zh: 阿波罗卖 450 钱币，萨尼卖 10 信用点；任务“与我同形”要 5 根，买就行。

verdict.en: Worth learning if you upgrade Anvil, Rascal or Hullcracker; otherwise ignore.
verdict.zh: 要升级“铁砧”“无赖”“裂甲者”等重型枪才值得学。

use.en: Heavy Gun Parts are the upgrade bottleneck for Anvil, Bettina, Hullcracker, Rascal and Vulcano.
use.zh: 重型枪械零件是“铁砧”“贝蒂娜”“裂甲者”“无赖”“火山”升级的瓶颈。

obtain.en: Research Station 2: 2,000 Research Points, 5 Simple Gun Parts, 1 Unusable Weapon; or scavenging. The parts also drop from ARC Bombardiers and Rocketeers.
obtain.zh: 研究站 2 级：2000 研究点数、5 个简易枪械零件、1 把报废的武器；或搜刮。“投弹手”和“火箭手”也掉零件。

tips.en: Celeste sells parts for seeds, 3 a day, so the blueprint only helps if you need more than that.
tips.zh: 塞莱斯特用种子卖，每天限 3 个，需求更大才需要蓝图。

verdict.en: Take the guaranteed copy from the Trophy Display project instead of buying it.
verdict.zh: 战利品展示架项目送一份，不必另花研究点数。

obtain.en: Reward in Stage 1 (Roaming Threats) of the Trophy Display project. Also scavenging, or Research Station 2 for 2,000 Research Points, 5 Simple Gun Parts and 1 Unusable Weapon.
obtain.zh: 战利品展示架项目第 1 阶段“游荡的威胁”奖励；也可搜刮，或研究站 2 级换（2000 研究点数、5 个简易枪械零件、1 把报废的武器）。

tips.en: The same project pays out for Stage 4 Bobcat blueprint, so stage 1 is worth finishing anyway.
tips.zh: 这个项目第 4 阶段还送“山猫”蓝图，第 1 阶段本来就值得做。

verdict.en: A must for ARC bosses, and it is a quest reward you should just finish.
verdict.zh: 打 ARC 首领必备，任务奖励，做完就有。

use.en: The Hullcracker fires explosives that only detonate on ARC, so one source says it does no damage to players: bring a second gun for PvP.
use.zh: “裂甲者”爆炸弹只对 ARC 起爆，有攻略称对玩家无伤害，PvP 要另带枪。

obtain.en: Quest The Major's Footlocker from Tian Wen: recover Aiva's mementos from the top floor of the westmost Ruby Residence apartment on Dam Battlegrounds. Or Research Station 3 for 4,500 Research Points. Shani no longer sells it after 2.0.
obtain.zh: 完成天玟的任务“少校的储物柜”：到大坝战场红宝石宅邸最西侧公寓的顶层取回遗物。或研究站 3 级换（4500 研究点数）。2.0 后萨尼不再出售。

tips.en: Older guides say to buy it for 30,000 coins or Cred, which is out of date.
tips.zh: 旧攻略说可花 30000 买，已过时。

verdict.en: A strong early shotgun that costs little to build; research it rather than wait on a drop.
verdict.zh: 前期强力霰弹枪，造价低，直接研究别等掉落。

obtain.en: Research Station 1 for 2,000 Research Points and 5 Shredder Gyros is the reliable way. Drops are low (guides say 1-2%) from Raider containers on all maps, Marano Station is a suggested spot, and the Uncovered Caches event raises odds.
obtain.zh: 研究站 1 级换：2000 研究点数加 5 个“粉碎者”陀螺仪，最稳。奇袭者容器掉率低（攻略称 1-2%），可去马拉诺车站，“揭开储藏点”事件几率更高。

tips.en: Build is Gunsmith 1 with Mechanical Components and Simple Gun Parts.
tips.zh: 武器工作台 1 级，用机械元件和简易枪械零件造。

verdict.en: Situational: faster aiming and draw, with a recoil penalty.
verdict.zh: 看情况：开镜和拔枪更快，后坐力变差。

use.en: The stock speeds up aim-down-sights and draw but adds 50% vertical recoil, for fifteen weapons including Il Toro and Hullcracker.
use.zh: 枪托加快开镜和拔枪，垂直后坐力 +50%，适配约十五把枪，含“公牛”和“裂甲者”。

obtain.en: Scavenging only; no Research Station route or quest is listed.
obtain.zh: 只能搜刮，没有研究站或任务途径。

tips.en: Craft needs Gunsmith 3, 2 Mod Components and 5 Duct Tape.
tips.zh: 合成需武器工作台 3 级、2 个改装零件、5 卷胶带。

verdict.en: Good for dedicated looters: a safe pocket that holds any item, in exchange for weight.
verdict.zh: 适合专职搜刮：安全口袋可放任意物品，代价是负重。

obtain.en: Research Station 3 for 3,000 Research Points, 5 ARC Circuitry and 5 Canisters, or scavenging.
obtain.zh: 研究站 3 级：3000 研究点数、5 个ARC线圈、5 个小罐；或搜刮。

tips.en: The augment is crafted at Gear Bench 3; the wiki lists no community review yet.
tips.zh: 护甲在装备工作台 3 级制造；暂无社区评价。

verdict.en: A pure scavenging find with no known fixed spot; learn it only if you want the big-pack Survivor build.
verdict.zh: 只能靠搜刮碰运气，没有固定刷新点，想要大背包流再学。

obtain.en: No quest or project rewards it and the community pages name no container, so treat it as random blue-tier loot. It cannot be researched at the Research Station. Run Night Raids and locked rooms, and keep it in a Safe Pocket: it is only learned once you extract.
obtain.zh: 没有任务或项目奖励，社区资料也没写出具体容器，只能当作随机战利品。研究站无法研究它。多跑夜间奇袭和上锁房间，放进安全口袋，成功撤离后才算学会。

tips.en: Making the augment later needs a Gear Bench level 3 and Processors, so check your bench before you spend farming runs on it.
tips.zh: 之后制作需要装备工作台 3 级和处理器，先确认工作台等级再专门去刷。

verdict.en: Free from a Celeste quest, so never pay Research Points for it.
verdict.zh: 塞莱斯特的任务白送，别花研究点数去买。

use.en: The grenade sticks to a surface and pulls ARC attention and fire toward it, which is useful for slipping past a patrol or splitting a group.
use.zh: 手雷会粘在表面上吸引附近 ARC 的注意和火力，适合绕过巡逻或拆开一群敌人。

obtain.en: Finish Greasing Her Palms from Celeste: visit the Locked Room in the Water Treatment Control building on Dam Battlegrounds, scope the rocket thrusters southwest of the Rocket Assembly at The Spaceport, and check the barricaded area on floor 6 of the Space Travel Building in Buried City.
obtain.zh: 完成塞莱斯特的任务“打通通路”：大坝战场水处理控制楼的上锁房间、太空港火箭组装楼西南的巨型推进器、掩埋废城太空旅行大楼 6 层的封锁区域。

tips.en: The three objectives are on three different maps, so combine them with other tasks and keep the loadout cheap.
tips.zh: 三个目标分在三张地图，顺路和其他任务一起做，带便宜装备即可。

verdict.en: Skip it unless you plan to craft the Osprey, which eats three Medium Gun Parts.
verdict.zh: 不打算造“鱼鹰”就别学，它要 3 个中型枪械零件。

obtain.en: It is a scavenged drop with no named container, or you can research it at Research Station level 2 for Research Points and Simple Gun Parts. The wiki's two recipes disagree, so check the station screen before you commit.
obtain.zh: 靠搜刮随机掉落，容器不明；也可在研究站 2 级用研究点数和简易枪械零件研究。维基给出的两个配方不一致，投入前先看游戏内研究界面。

tips.en: Guides rank it below new weapons and gadgets; buy it after the Osprey blueprint, not before.
tips.zh: 攻略把它排在新武器和小工具之后，先拿到“鱼鹰”蓝图再说。

verdict.en: Cheap recoil control that is nice to have, not urgent.
verdict.zh: 便宜的后坐力改善，有当然好，但不急。

obtain.en: Random scavenged loot, or research it at Research Station level 2 for 2,000 Research Points plus Rusty ARC Steel and a Steel Cable. Players ranking research spend put tier-II attachments after new weapons and gadgets, so wait until those are done.
obtain.zh: 随机搜刮，或在研究站 2 级花 2000 研究点数加生锈的ARC钢材和钢缆研究。玩家的研究顺序里二级配件排在新武器和小工具之后，先放一放。

tips.en: Crafting the attachment needs Gunsmith level 2, so it fits mid-game.
tips.zh: 制作配件需要武器工作台 2 级，适合中期。

verdict.en: Only worth chasing for a main gun with heavy recoil; it cannot be bought with Research Points.
verdict.zh: 只有主力枪后坐力很大时才值得追，研究站里买不到。

obtain.en: Scavenging is the only listed source and no spawn spot is documented, so it is a lucky find. Run high-risk zones, locked rooms and Night Raids, and extract with it before it counts.
obtain.zh: 资料只列了搜刮一个来源，也没记载刷新点，全看运气。多跑高风险区、上锁房间和夜间奇袭，撤离成功才算学会。

tips.en: Making it needs Gunsmith level 3 and Mod Components, so a tier-II brake is the practical stopgap.
tips.zh: 制作需要武器工作台 3 级和改装零件，在此之前用二级制退器过渡。

verdict.en: A top-priority Research Station buy: a solid sniper blueprint that is hard to find in loot.
verdict.zh: 研究站里值得优先买的蓝图，狙击枪实用，掉落又难碰。

use.en: The Osprey is a bolt-action medium-ammo sniper, so the blueprint matters if you want a long-range PvP or ARC option.
use.zh: “鱼鹰”是中口径栓动狙击枪，想要远距离对枪或打 ARC 就该学。

obtain.en: Weapon cases and locked rooms on Dam Battlegrounds and The Spaceport are the usual farming spots, with Night Raid and Hurricane raising loot quality. The faster route is Research Station level 2: 3,000 Research Points, 3 Sentinel Firing Cores and a Camera Lens.
obtain.zh: 常见刷法是大坝战场和太空港的武器箱与上锁房间，夜间奇袭和飓风会提升战利品质量。更稳的路线是研究站 2 级：3000 研究点数、3 个“哨卫”发射核心和 1 个相机镜头。

tips.en: Crafting the gun later needs Gunsmith 2 and three Medium Gun Parts, so learn that blueprint too.
tips.zh: 之后造枪需要武器工作台 2 级和 3 个中型枪械零件，记得也学那张蓝图。

tips.en: Drops are RNG; do not spend many raids hunting it when Research Points can buy it.
tips.zh: 掉落看运气，能用研究点数换就别靠连跑几局去刷。

verdict.en: A random-drop stability mod with no research shortcut; pick it up if it shows, do not hunt it.
verdict.zh: 稳定性配件，只能随机掉落，碰到就学，不用专门刷。

obtain.en: Scavenging is the only listed source, with no quest, project or Research Station route. Loot weapon cases, locked rooms and other high-value containers, and put the blueprint in a Safe Pocket before extracting.
obtain.zh: 只有搜刮一个来源，没有任务、项目或研究站途径。翻武器箱、上锁房间等高价值容器，拿到后放进安全口袋再撤离。

tips.en: Crafting it needs Gunsmith 3, Mod Components and Duct Tape, so it is a late-mid unlock.
tips.zh: 制作需要武器工作台 3 级、改装零件和胶带，算中后期解锁。

verdict.en: Worth learning if you run Riven Tides a lot: it removes lethal falls from the vertical map.
verdict.zh: 常跑裂潮镇就值得学，能让你从高处安全落地。

use.en: It slows your fall in the air, with a short wind-up and a power limit, so it works as a quick shortcut and an escape from rooftops.
use.zh: 它在空中减缓下落速度，有启动延迟且能量有限，适合当近路和屋顶逃生。

obtain.en: Search Riven Tides: Hotel Panorama Azzurro south of Azzurro Beach (lockers and dressers) is the most reported spot, plus Port Authority and its locked rooms. Night Raid improves the odds. Or research it at Research Station level 3 for 3,000 Research Points, 2 Cooling Fans and Advanced Electrical Components.
obtain.zh: 去裂潮镇找：阿祖罗海滩南边的蔚蓝全景酒店（储物柜、梳妆台）报告最多，港务局和上锁房间也行，夜间奇袭概率更高。也可在研究站 3 级用 3000 研究点数、2 个冷却风扇和高级电子元件研究。

tips.en: The device needs Utility Station 3, a Power Rod and a Turbine Compressor from Riven Tides turbines, which is a lot of prep.
tips.zh: 制作需要工具工作台 3 级、能量管和裂潮镇涡轮上的“涡轮”压缩机，前置准备不少。

verdict.en: A cheap early Research Station pick if you like trap play, otherwise skip.
verdict.zh: 喜欢布陷阱的话，是研究站里便宜的早期选择，不然可以跳过。

obtain.en: It is a scavenged drop; one source points at Stella Montis, another lists several maps with Night Raid as the best condition, so the spawn data conflicts. The sure route is Research Station level 1: 1,000 Research Points and 3 Industrial Batteries.
obtain.zh: 靠搜刮掉落；有资料说在星辰山，另一处列了多张地图并推荐夜间奇袭，说法不一。稳妥的是研究站 1 级：1000 研究点数和 3 个工业电池。

tips.en: The mine itself only needs Explosives Station 1, so it unlocks very early once you own the blueprint.
tips.zh: 地雷本身只要爆炸物工作台 1 级，拿到蓝图后很早就能造。

verdict.en: A good anti-ARC backup launcher; buy it with Research Points rather than farming for it.
verdict.zh: 不错的对 ARC 副武器，直接用研究点数换，别去刷。

use.en: It is lighter than the Hullcracker and handles armored ARC, but it only damages ARC, loads one round at a time and is inaccurate past about 14 m.
use.zh: 比“裂甲者”轻，能对付装甲 ARC，但只伤 ARC、一次装一发，14 米外准头差。

obtain.en: No fixed spawn. Reported spots: Security Breach cabinets, Hurricane First Wave Caches, locked key rooms and weapon crates, and Ermal's weekly trader rotation may stock it. Research Station level 2 costs 3,000 Research Points, 2 Bombardier Cells and 15 ARC Alloy.
obtain.zh: 没有固定刷新点。报告较多的是安防突破柜、飓风“第一波”箱、上锁钥匙房和武器箱，商人埃尔马尔的每周轮换也可能上架。研究站 2 级需要 3000 研究点数、2 个“投弹手”电池和 15 个ARC合金。

tips.en: Crafting it needs 5 Canisters and 3 Heavy Gun Parts, which players call steep for a blue weapon.
tips.zh: 制作要 5 个罐体和 3 个重型枪械零件，玩家觉得对蓝色武器来说偏贵。

tips.en: Its blasts are loud and can draw other raiders.
tips.zh: 爆炸声很大，会引来其他奇袭者。

verdict.en: You get it for free during the Outpost unlock, so there is nothing to hunt.
verdict.zh: 解锁哨站的过程中白送，不用特意找。

obtain.en: It is the stage 2 reward (Gather Building Materials) of the Sheltered Retreat Outpost project, which opens at level 18. The wiki also lists scavenging, but the project is the dependable way.
obtain.zh: 它是哨站解锁项目“掩护撤退”第 2 阶段（收集建筑材料）的奖励，18 级开启。维基也列了搜刮，但走项目最稳。

tips.en: Making the stick needs only Utility Station 2 and a few Chemicals, so it is cheap light for dark interiors and Night Raids.
tips.zh: 制作只要工具工作台 2 级和少量化学品，夜间奇袭和黑暗室内用很划算。

verdict.en: Cheap but niche: it is a signaling tool, so it is a low-priority research buy.
verdict.zh: 便宜但用途窄，只是信号工具，研究优先级低。

use.en: You place it and trigger it by hand to launch a distress flare, which fits baiting or marking, not combat.
use.zh: 放置后手动触发发射求救信号弹，适合引诱或标记，不是战斗道具。

obtain.en: Scavenging or Research Station level 1 at 500 Research Points and 25 Chemicals, the cheapest RP price among my batch. No container or quest is documented, so research is the practical route if you want it.
obtain.zh: 靠搜刮，或在研究站 1 级花 500 研究点数和 25 个化学品研究，是这批里最便宜的。没有记载容器或任务，想要的话研究最实际。

verdict.en: A handy anti-ARC grenade at a cheap price; a good early research choice.
verdict.zh: 便宜好用的反 ARC 手雷，适合早期研究。

use.en: It homes in on one nearby ARC and explodes on contact, so it is good for finishing a damaged machine.
use.zh: 会追踪附近一台 ARC 并撞击爆炸，适合补刀残血机器。

obtain.en: No documented container or quest; it drops as scavenged loot. Research it at Research Station level 1 for 1,000 Research Points and a Rocketeer Driver, which beats farming.
obtain.zh: 没有记载容器或任务，属于随机搜刮。可在研究站 1 级用 1000 研究点数和 1 个“火箭手”引擎研究，比刷划算。

tips.en: The grenade itself needs Explosives Station 1, Crude Explosives and ARC Alloy.
tips.zh: 手雷本身需要爆炸物工作台 1 级、粗制炸药和ARC合金。

verdict.en: Worth it only if you run shotguns; the research cost is steep for a modest spread tweak.
verdict.zh: 只有常用霰弹枪才值，散布小幅改善，研究价格偏高。

obtain.en: Random scavenged loot, or Research Station level 2 for 2,000 Research Points, 5 Rusty ARC Steel and a Heavy Gun Parts. No container is named, so research is more predictable.
obtain.zh: 随机搜刮，或在研究站 2 级用 2000 研究点数、5 个生锈的ARC钢材和 1 个重型枪械零件研究。没有指明容器，研究更可控。

tips.en: Attachment blueprints rank below weapons and gadgets for Research Points, so spend on those first.
tips.zh: 研究点数先买武器和小工具，配件蓝图靠后。

verdict.en: A late pick-up for dedicated shotgun users; no research route, so it is luck only.
verdict.zh: 给专精霰弹枪的玩家的后期蓝图，不能研究，纯看运气。

obtain.en: Only scavenging is listed; there is no quest, project or Research Station recipe. Check weapon cases, locked rooms and high-risk zones, and secure it in a Safe Pocket.
obtain.zh: 只列了搜刮，没有任务、项目或研究站配方。翻武器箱、上锁房间和高风险区，并放入安全口袋。

tips.en: Do not hold a run for it; tier II gives much of the same effect for less.
tips.zh: 别为它专门耗一局，二级收束器效果相近，成本更低。

verdict.en: Take it from the Trophy Display project instead of farming it.
verdict.zh: 走战利品展示架项目拿，别去刷。

obtain.en: It is the Trophy Display project stage 3 (Ferocious Foes) reward. That stage asks for ARC Performance Steel, Kinetic Converter, Shredder Gyros, Anvil Splitters, Leaper Pulse Units, Raider Tokens and Bastion Cells. The wiki lists scavenging too, but with no named spot.
obtain.zh: 它是战利品展示架项目第 3 阶段（凶暴的敌兽）的奖励，阶段要求ARC高性能钢、动能转换器、“粉碎者”陀螺仪、“铁砧”分流器、“跳跃者”脉冲单元、奇袭者代币和“堡垒”电池等。维基也列了搜刮，但没有具体地点。

tips.en: That stage is expensive; check whether you need the silencer before pouring materials into it.
tips.zh: 这一阶段材料开销大，先想清楚是否真需要消音器再投入。

verdict.en: A late utility grenade; stun is nice but the unlock chain is long.
verdict.zh: 后期功能手雷，眩晕不错，但解锁链条太长。

use.en: It detonates after a short delay and stuns everything in its radius, handy for pushing a room or stopping a charging ARC.
use.zh: 延迟引爆并眩晕范围内的目标，适合攻房或打断冲锋的 ARC。

obtain.en: It is scavenged loot with no named container, or Research Station level 2 for 2,000 Research Points, 3 Industrial Batteries and 5 Hornet Drivers. Making it requires Explosives Station 3, so it is a late-mid goal.
obtain.zh: 随机搜刮，容器不明；或在研究站 2 级用 2000 研究点数、3 个工业级电池和 5 个“马蜂”引擎研究。制作需要爆炸物工作台 3 级，属于中后期目标。

verdict.en: Worth grabbing early if you play quietly; one known farm spot makes it reachable.
verdict.zh: 喜欢潜行的话早点拿，有一个已知刷点。

obtain.en: Search the containers in the Arbusto Tower Pharmacy in Buried City; the front door is barricaded, so breach it or take the back stairwell up. It can also be researched at Research Station level 2 for 2,000 Research Points, 5 Rusty ARC Steel and a Cooling Coil.
obtain.zh: 去掩埋废城阿布斯托塔楼的药房翻容器；正门被封，可炸开或走后楼梯上去。也可在研究站 2 级用 2000 研究点数、5 个生锈的ARC钢材和 1 个冷却管研究。

tips.en: It only slightly dampens noise, so do not expect stealth from it alone.
tips.zh: 只是小幅降噪，别指望单靠它实现潜行。

verdict.en: A mid-priority upgrade for stealth builds; research it once you have the Level 3 station.
verdict.zh: 潜行流的中等优先升级，研究站升到 3 级再考虑。

obtain.en: Random loot without a named container, or Research Station level 3 for 3,000 Research Points, 5 ARC Performance Steel and Advanced Mechanical Components. Learning Silencer I first costs less and covers the same slot.
obtain.zh: 随机掉落，容器不明；或在研究站 3 级用 3000 研究点数、5 个ARC高性能钢和高级机械元件研究。先学消音器 I 成本更低，占同一格位。

tips.en: Crafting needs Gunsmith 3, Mod Components and 8 Wires.
tips.zh: 制作需要武器工作台 3 级、改装零件和 8 根导线。

verdict.en: A useful escape tool; a solid research buy once you hit station level 2.
verdict.zh: 实用的逃生道具，研究站到 2 级后值得买。

use.en: The cloud blocks sight for ARC and other raiders, so use it to cover a revive, a crossing or a retreat.
use.zh: 烟幕遮挡 ARC 和其他奇袭者的视线，用来掩护救人、过空地或撤退。

obtain.en: Scavenged loot with no named spot, or Research Station level 2 for 2,000 Research Points, 3 Gas Grenades and Household Cleaner. The wiki's workbench recipe differs, so confirm in the game.
obtain.zh: 随机搜刮，地点不明；或在研究站 2 级用 2000 研究点数、3 个毒气手雷和家用清洁剂研究。维基工作台配方不同，请以游戏内为准。

verdict.en: A late project reward, not a farm target; only chase it if you want the Trophy Display chain.
verdict.zh: 后期项目奖励，不是刷取目标，只有做展示架项目时才会拿到。

obtain.en: It is the final stage 5 (Imposing Behemoths) reward of Trophy Display. That stage wants Exodus Modules, 2 Snap Hooks, Geiger Counters, an Aphelion, Bombardier Cells, Raider Tokens and Matriarch Reactors. No Research Station route.
obtain.zh: 它是战利品展示架第 5 阶段（巍峨的巨兽）的奖励，阶段要求离巢模块、2 个安全钩、盖革计数器、“远日点”、“投弹手”电池、奇袭者代币和“族母”反应堆等。研究站里没有。

tips.en: The stage asks for 2 finished Snap Hooks, so you must have crafted the item once before the blueprint even arrives.
tips.zh: 阶段要求交 2 个成品安全钩，意味着蓝图到手前你得已经造过它。

verdict.en: A modest handling upgrade; research it late, after weapons and gadgets.
verdict.zh: 小幅操控提升，放到武器和小工具之后再研究。

obtain.en: Scavenged loot with no documented container, or Research Station level 2 for 2,000 Research Points, 5 ARC Flex Rubber and a Rubber Pad. The wiki's infobox lists a different recipe, so check in the game before spending.
obtain.zh: 随机搜刮，容器不明；或在研究站 2 级用 2000 研究点数、5 个ARC弹性橡胶和橡胶垫研究。维基信息框的配方不同，花费前先在游戏里确认。

verdict.en: A luck-only attachment blueprint; use tier II meanwhile.
verdict.zh: 只能靠运气的配件蓝图，先用二级顶着。

obtain.en: Scavenging is the sole listed source, with no Research Station recipe and no named container. Loot weapon cases and locked rooms, and extract with it to learn it.
obtain.zh: 只列了搜刮，没有研究站配方，也没有指明容器。翻武器箱和上锁房间，撤离成功后才能学会。

tips.en: Making it needs Gunsmith 3, Mod Components and Duct Tape.
tips.zh: 制作需要武器工作台 3 级、改装零件和胶带。

verdict.en: No fixed drop spot, so unlock it at the Research Station if you want the entry-level Stiletto.
verdict.zh: 没有固定掉点，想要入门级“细剑”就去研究站解锁。

obtain.en: It is random loot from containers and weapon cases, with no map condition needed. The wiki also lists the Research Station as a source, and one guide says most blueprints can be unlocked there with enough Research Points. The wiki's two unlock recipes disagree, so read the in-game price first.
obtain.zh: 属随机战利品，来自容器和武器箱，不需要地图条件。百科同时把研究站列为来源，有攻略称多数蓝图只要研究点数够就能解锁。百科给出的两套解锁条件互相矛盾，先看游戏内实际价格。

tips.en: Rated an uncommon, early-game rifle, so don't burn a long farming session on this blueprint.
tips.zh: 这是定位偏入门的非稀有步枪，不值得为它专门长时间刷图。

verdict.en: Only drops during an Electromagnetic Storm; check containers if you are there anyway, don't build runs around it.
verdict.zh: 只在电磁风暴期间掉落；赶上了就顺手搜，不必专门为它出击。

obtain.en: Load into a map with Electromagnetic Storm active, which is mostly Dam Battlegrounds. It can sit in almost any container: lockers, drawers, crates. Guides suggest the Control Tower and nearby admin buildings on Dam. Not a quest reward.
obtain.zh: 进入有电磁风暴的地图，主要是大坝战场。几乎任何容器都可能出：储物柜、抽屉、板条箱。攻略推荐大坝的控制塔及周边行政楼。没有任务奖励。

tips.en: Do short loops of one or two buildings rather than clearing the whole map, and extract as soon as you find it.
tips.zh: 在一两栋楼之间短线循环，别清全图；拿到后尽快撤离。

tips.en: The unlock also needs an Explosives Station level 3 and a Hornet Driver, so plan the parts first.
tips.zh: 制作要爆炸物工作台3级和一个“马蜂”引擎，先备好材料。

verdict.en: A random augment blueprint; worth taking if you find it, not worth a dedicated hunt.
verdict.zh: 随机出的增幅器蓝图，遇到就拿，不必专门去刷。

obtain.en: The wiki's blueprint table lists Stella Montis and The Blue Gate, in Medical and Security containers, and it can also drop from a killed ARC Surveyor. Reinforced Reception on Blue Gate is the best-known augment room, though crowded. Night Raids give better loot.
obtain.zh: 百科蓝图表列出星辰山和蓝门，来自医疗类和安保类容器，击杀ARC勘测师也可能掉。蓝门的加固前台是最知名的增幅器房间，但人多。夜间奇袭的战利品更好。

tips.en: The wiki lists two different unlock costs, one at the Research Station; confirm in-game before gathering parts.
tips.zh: 百科给出两套解锁条件，其中一套在研究站；备料前先在游戏里确认。

verdict.en: Pure support augment, and only luck finds the blueprint; farm it only if your squad runs a medic.
verdict.zh: 纯辅助向增幅器，蓝图全凭运气；队里有医疗位再去刷。

obtain.en: Stella Montis and The Blue Gate, from Medical and Security containers. Reinforced Reception on Blue Gate is the usual pick: breach the room, open every locker and medical drawer. One guide lists White Medical Drawers, Medical Bags and Blue Cabinets as the useful medical containers.
obtain.zh: 星辰山和蓝门，来自医疗类和安保类容器。常见选择是蓝门加固前台：破门进房，开光所有储物柜和医疗抽屉。有攻略点名白色医疗抽屉、医疗包和蓝色柜子。

tips.en: Bring a cheap kit with a free Safe Pocket slot, because the room is contested and the drop is pure RNG.
tips.zh: 带便宜的装备并空出安全口袋，那里抢的人多，掉落全看运气。

verdict.en: Worth grabbing if you play in a squad: the augment is a built-in revive, but the drop is pure luck.
verdict.zh: 组队玩值得拿：这个增幅器自带复活能力，但掉落全看运气。

obtain.en: Best known from Reinforced Reception on Blue Gate: run the tunnels from spawn, breach in, and open lockers, augment cases and medical drawers. Stella Montis augment rooms (Lobby, Business Center, Archives keyroom) also work. Players carrying it can drop it too.
obtain.zh: 最知名的是蓝门加固前台：出生后跑隧道破门，开储物柜、增幅器箱和医疗抽屉。星辰山的增幅器房间（大厅、商务中心、档案馆钥匙房）也行。带着它的玩家也可能掉落。

tips.en: Expect heavy competition at Reinforced Reception; extract right after you find it.
tips.zh: 加固前台竞争激烈，拿到就尽快撤离。

verdict.en: A niche epic augment blueprint added late; take it if it drops, but nothing in the wiki says it is a priority.
verdict.zh: 后加入的小众史诗增幅器蓝图；掉了就拿，但没有资料说它值得优先。

obtain.en: One Riven Tides guide points to Security containers first, with Medical containers as a weaker backup. On Riven Tides try the Port Authority Buildings and Hotel Panorama Azzurro; backups are the Buried City Hospital and Blue Gate Reinforced Reception lockers. Locked rooms and offices are favoured.
obtain.zh: 一篇裂潮镇攻略首推安保类容器，医疗类容器次之。裂潮镇可去港务局大楼和蔚蓝全景酒店；备选是掩埋废城医院和蓝门加固前台的储物柜。上锁的房间和办公室更值得搜。

tips.en: The wiki shows no Research Station route for this one, so it has to be found as loot.
tips.zh: 百科没有列出研究站途径，只能靠搜刮获得。

verdict.en: One of the easier blueprints to find, and a cheap scouting tool; learn it when it shows up.
verdict.zh: 属于较容易找到的蓝图，是便宜的侦察工具；见到就学。

obtain.en: Any map, any condition, from Electrical containers, so check those as you pass. The Research Station can also unlock it at level 2 for a modest cost.
obtain.zh: 所有地图、任意条件都有机会，出自电类容器，路过时顺手开。研究站2级也能以较低成本解锁。

tips.en: Not worth a detour; if you can't find it, the Research Station route is the fallback.
tips.zh: 不值得绕路；找不到就走研究站这条路。

verdict.en: One of the rarest weapon blueprints: don't plan around it, grab it if you spot it.
verdict.zh: 最稀有的武器蓝图之一：别指望，见到就拿。

obtain.en: Epic drop that needs a Night Raid or Hurricane. Buried City's Space Travel building (second-highest floor, left rooms) is the best-known spot; Residential containers and First Wave Caches also roll it. Daytime odds are very low.
obtain.zh: 史诗级掉落，需要夜间奇袭或飓风。最知名的点位是掩埋废城航天大楼次高层左侧房间；住宅类容器和第一波补给也可能掉。白天掉率极低。

tips.en: Hurricane puts Tempest and Vulcano in the pool together, so it is the best condition to hunt in.
tips.zh: 飓风会同时把风暴和火山放进掉落池，是最值得刷的条件。

tips.en: Unlocking needs Gunsmith level 3 and a Magnetic Accelerator; it cannot be done at the Research Station.
tips.zh: 解锁要武器工作台3级和磁力加速器，研究站不能解锁。

verdict.en: New in 2.0 with no mapped drop yet; the Research Station is the realistic way to get it.
verdict.zh: 2.0新增，还没人整理出掉点；研究站是现实的获取途径。

obtain.en: The wiki lists only Scavenging and the Research Station, with no maps or containers, and no quest or project gives it. Plan on the Research Station and check the exact price in-game, because the page shows two conflicting recipes.
obtain.zh: 百科只列出搜刮和研究站，没有地图和容器信息，也没有任务或项目奖励。以研究站为主，价格先在游戏内确认，页面上有两套互相矛盾的配方。

tips.en: Ignore sellers offering it for real money; it can be unlocked in-game.
tips.zh: 别理会卖蓝图的代练，游戏内就能解锁。

verdict.en: Findable in Raider containers on any map; learn it if you want the weapon, no need for a special route.
verdict.zh: 任何地图的奇袭者容器都可能出；想要这把武器就学，不用特别规划路线。

obtain.en: The wiki lists all maps and any condition, in Raider containers. That means weapon cases and Raider caches. Night Raids and locked rooms should help, as with other weapon blueprints.  Or take the Research Station 2 route.
obtain.zh: 百科列为所有地图、任意条件，出自奇袭者类容器，即武器箱和奇袭者补给。夜间奇袭和上锁房间应当更有利，和其他武器蓝图一样。研究站2级也可解锁。

tips.en: Unlocking via workshop needs Gunsmith level 2 or 3 depending on which wiki recipe is right; check first.
tips.zh: 工坊解锁需要武器工作台2级或3级，取决于百科哪套配方正确，先确认。

verdict.en: Stella Montis loot only, so learn it only if you already run that map.
verdict.zh: 只在星辰山出，平时就跑那张图再去找。

obtain.en: The wiki's blueprint table lists Stella Montis, any condition, any container. No room is named. Sources agree it is high-tier loot, so favour locked rooms and the augment-rich Security Checkpoint area.  Or take the Research Station 2 route.
obtain.zh: 百科蓝图表列为星辰山、任意条件、任意容器，没有指明房间。多方说法一致认为属高阶战利品，所以优先搜上锁房间和增幅器密集的安全检查站。研究站2级也可解锁。

tips.en: Don't trust guides that give exact coordinates for it; none could be verified.
tips.zh: 别信给出具体坐标的攻略，目前没有可验证的。

verdict.en: Take the guaranteed quest reward from Sparks Fly instead of hoping for a drop.
verdict.zh: 直接做任务“灭蜂大计”拿保底奖励，别等掉落。

obtain.en: Sparks Fly gives one copy, and it can also be scavenged on any map. Trading it from Shani was removed in 2.0.  Or take the Research Station 2 route.
obtain.zh: “灭蜂大计”任务奖励1份，也可在任意地图搜刮。2.0起不能再向萨尼购买。研究站2级也可解锁。

tips.en: Do the quest first; every other route costs more time.
tips.zh: 先做任务，其他途径都更费时间。

verdict.en: A weapon-case blueprint with no fixed spot; worth learning if you like close-range PvP pistols.
verdict.zh: 武器箱里出的蓝图，没有固定位置；喜欢近距离PvP手枪就值得学。

obtain.en: Raider containers on any map. Weapon crates and Raider caches have the best odds, then Security Lockers, with locked rooms and Night Raids raising them. Dam Battlegrounds' Control Tower is a frequent suggestion.  Or take the Research Station 2 route.
obtain.zh: 所有地图的奇袭者容器。武器箱和奇袭者补给概率最高，其次是安保储物柜，上锁房间和夜间奇袭会更好。大坝战场控制塔常被推荐。研究站2级也可解锁。

tips.en: Put it in your Safe Pocket right away, then learn it back at base.
tips.zh: 拿到后立刻放进安全口袋，回基地再学习。

tips.en: A claimed locked hospital room on Buried City is unconfirmed; don't count on it.
tips.zh: 掩埋废城医院上锁房间的说法未证实，别指望。

verdict.en: A cheap, common attachment blueprint; check Residential containers or buy time at the Research Station.
verdict.zh: 便宜常见的配件蓝图；搜住宅类容器，或走研究站。

obtain.en: All maps, any condition, from Residential containers such as wardrobes and dressers.  Or take the Research Station 2 route.
obtain.zh: 所有地图、任意条件，出自衣柜、梳妆台等住宅类容器。研究站2级也可解锁。

tips.en: Recoil gains are moderate, so learn it only if you build rifles.
tips.zh: 后坐力削减幅度一般，玩步枪再学。

verdict.en: Better recoil control but rarer than Grip II; condition raids are the best bet.
verdict.zh: 后坐力控制更好，但比二级握把稀有；条件对局最有机会。

obtain.en: Residential containers during Electromagnetic Storm, Locked Gate or Night Raid. Research Station 3 also lists it; check the price in-game.
obtain.zh: 电磁风暴、上锁的大门或夜间奇袭期间的住宅类容器。研究站3级也列有它，价格先在游戏内确认。

tips.en: Learn Grip II first and only chase this one if you use a high-recoil weapon.
tips.zh: 先学二级握把，用高后坐力武器再追这个。

verdict.en: Reasonable heal blueprint from Medical containers; learn it, there's no reason to sell it.
verdict.zh: 医疗容器里能找到的治疗蓝图；学掉，不必卖。

obtain.en: All maps, Medical containers and ARC Surveyor kills. The Buried City Hospital and Dam Testing Annex are good medical farm spots. It is also a Trials reward and an item in the Trophy Display project (stage 2 part 1).
obtain.zh: 所有地图，来自医疗类容器和ARC勘测师。掩埋废城医院和大坝测试附楼是不错的医疗区。也是试炼奖励，并与展示柜项目第一阶段第2步有关。

tips.en: The wiki shows a Research Station route, so you don't need to rely on drops.
tips.zh: 百科列出研究站途径，不必只靠掉落。

verdict.en: Notoriously rare as a drop; finishing Worth Your Salt is the sure way to get it.
verdict.zh: 掉落极稀有；完成电池的“盐”伸是稳拿的办法。

obtain.en: The quest Worth Your Salt gives one, but it sits late in Celeste's chain. Otherwise try Medical containers and ARC Surveyors (Testing Annex on Dam, Hospital on Buried City) or First Wave Caches in Hurricane.
obtain.zh: 任务电池的“盐”伸奖励1份，但在塞莱斯特任务链靠后。否则可搜医疗类容器和ARC勘测师（大坝测试附楼、掩埋废城医院），或飓风中的第一波补给。

tips.en: If you are deep in Celeste's quests, do it; if not, don't restart the chain just for this.
tips.zh: 已经推进到塞莱斯特的后期任务就做；否则别为它从头打任务链。

verdict.en: Epic shotgun blueprint tied to the Spaceport Hidden Bunker and Hurricane; farm only while one is active.
verdict.zh: 史诗霰弹枪蓝图，与太空港隐藏地堡和飓风绑定；只在条件开启时刷。

obtain.en: Hidden Bunker event on The Spaceport: download the four antennas, open the bunker and every container, or search the Launch Towers' tops. In Hurricane it can come from First Wave Caches anywhere. Not craftable at the Research Station.
obtain.zh: 太空港隐藏地堡事件：下载四个天线数据，开启地堡并搜遍容器，或搜发射塔顶部。飓风期间任何地图的第一波补给也可能出。研究站不能解锁。

tips.en: Put it in the Safe Pocket right away; unlock needs Gunsmith level 3.
tips.zh: 立即放进安全口袋；解锁需要武器工作台3级。

verdict.en: A common Riven Tides novelty blueprint; learn it cheaply, it is no priority.
verdict.zh: 裂潮镇上常见的趣味蓝图；便宜学掉，不算优先。

obtain.en: Riven Tides, any container: cabinets, desks, lockers, suitcases. Hotel Panorama Azzurro first, then the Port Authority Buildings and docks. Backups: Buried City residences, Dam Research and Administration. The Research Station level 1 unlocks it cheaply.
obtain.zh: 裂潮镇任意容器：柜子、办公桌、储物柜、手提箱。先去蔚蓝全景酒店，再去港务局大楼和码头。备选：掩埋废城公寓、大坝研究与行政区。研究站1级即可低价解锁。

tips.en: The Research Station route is the cheapest of this batch, so just buy it.
tips.zh: 研究站途径在本批蓝图中最便宜，直接解锁即可。

verdict.en: Night Raid residential loot; a good anti-ARC grenade blueprint, worth farming in Buried City.
verdict.zh: 夜间奇袭的住宅类战利品；优秀的反ARC手雷蓝图，值得去掩埋废城刷。

obtain.en: Night Raid, in Residential containers on Buried City, Dam Battlegrounds or Stella Montis. Ruby Residences, Pale Apartments and Grandioso Apartments get named. Community data shows most finds outside keyed rooms. It also rolls in the Space Travel rooms alongside Tempest.
obtain.zh: 夜间奇袭，掩埋废城、大坝战场或星辰山的住宅类容器。红宝石公寓、苍白公寓和奢华公寓被点名。社区数据显示多数在非钥匙房间找到。航天大楼的房间也与风暴一同出。

tips.en: Open every locker, safe deposit box and drawer; unlock needs Explosives Station level 3.
tips.zh: 柜子、保险箱和抽屉都开；解锁需要爆炸物工作台3级。

verdict.en: New in 2.0 with no mapped drop; use the cheap Research Station route.
verdict.zh: 2.0新增，没有已知掉点；走便宜的研究站途径。

obtain.en: The wiki lists only Scavenging and the Research Station (level 1 recipe), and no quest or project. I found no drop guides yet, so unlock it there and check the price in-game.
obtain.zh: 百科只列出搜刮和研究站（1级配方），没有任务或项目奖励。尚未找到掉落攻略，建议在研究站解锁，价格先在游戏内确认。

tips.en: The page shows two different recipes; trust the in-game price.
tips.zh: 页面有两套配方，以游戏内价格为准。

verdict.en: Take the quest copy from Last Entry; the stick is cheap and the blueprint is easy.
verdict.zh: 拿“最后条目”的任务奖励；荧光棒便宜，蓝图也容易。

obtain.en: Last Entry gives one copy. Otherwise it is found on all maps in any container. The workshop route needs Utility Station level 2 and a few Chemicals, per the wiki.
obtain.zh: “最后条目”任务奖励1份。其他情况下所有地图任意容器都可能出。据百科，工坊解锁需要工具工作台2级和少量化学品。

tips.en: Not a priority; skip hunting if you don't need to mark routes.
tips.zh: 不是优先项；不用标记路线就不必特意找。
